frequency_question: How often does Congress successfully pass a joint resolution of disapproval overriding or avoiding a veto to block an executive nuclear or major defense agreement?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 agreements and major contentious foreign military sales subjected to statutory congressional review since the 1970s; excludes routine or non-contentious agreements that never faced a privileged resolution.
coverage_note: 5 major historical legislative veto/disapproval showdowns identified under similar statutory frameworks
known_gaps: Minor 123 agreements that never reached a floor vote due to lack of sponsor momentum are excluded as non-starters.
skeleton: Historical legislative challenges to major executive foreign/nuclear agreements under statutory review acts
multiplier: 1 hit out of 5 major formal challenges resulting in a passed resolution
validity_reason: Statutory mechanics of the Atomic Energy Act remain stable across administrations.
